meta.name: saas-revenue-growth-metrics
meta.description: Calculate SaaS revenue, retention, and growth metrics. Use when diagnosing momentum, churn, expansion, or product-market-fit signals.

copy.tagline: 计算SaaS收入、留存与增长指标
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要分析SaaS业务的收入、流失和增长趋势。
copy.tagline_en: Calculate SaaS revenue, retention, and growth metrics
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to analyze SaaS revenue, churn, and growth trends.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以帮你计算和解读 SaaS 收入、留存和增长指标，例如 MRR、ARR、流失率、净收入留存率等。它会根据你提供的数据给出计算公式、质量检查建议和基准参考。
howto.when: 当你询问 SaaS 业务健康度、产品市场匹配度、增长势头、流失或扩张信号时触发。

say.text: 帮我计算并解读我们的 MRR、流失率和 NRR，用于董事会汇报。
say.note: Claude 会给出计算过程和解读。

say.text: 解释总留存率和净留存率的区别，以及如何提升净留存率。
say.note: Claude 会解释概念并提供改进建议。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you calculate and interpret SaaS revenue, retention, and growth metrics such as MRR, ARR, churn rate, and net revenue retention. It provides formulas, quality checks, and benchmarks based on your data.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about SaaS business health, product-market fit, growth momentum, churn, or expansion signals.

say_en.text: Calculate and interpret our MRR, churn rate, and NRR for a board deck.
say_en.note: Claude will provide calculations and interpretation.

say_en.text: Explain the difference between gross and net revenue retention and how to improve net retention.
say_en.note: Claude will explain concepts and suggest improvements.
